title: Manage minimal label projects
description: Provide the visible minimal `LabelProject` lifecycle: create with a name, list, open, rename, and delete only after explicit confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can create a project with a stable identity and non-empty name
Created projects appear in a visible project list and can be opened
A user can rename a project without changing its identity
Deletion requires an explicit confirmation and cancellation preserves the project
Confirmed deletion removes the project from the list without showing false success on failure

steps.details: Introduce typed create, open, rename, list, and delete action boundaries using `LabelProject` identity and name; keep storage behind an injected repository contract.
Add a labeled project-name input, native create button, empty state, and project list whose entries expose stable open actions.
Provide a labeled rename control for the open or selected project, validate a non-empty name, and preserve the existing project identity.
Use an accessible confirmation dialog with distinct cancel and destructive confirm actions; keep focus behavior predictable and update the list only after success.
Exercise create, list, open, rename, cancel-delete, and confirm-delete through public UI controls and assert names and state transitions.

technicalNotes: Project names are private local user data and must not be transmitted or logged unnecessarily.
Do not conflate the minimal project lifecycle with later content authoring.
